title: Missing and dead scientists: Loureiro, Gilmore, McCasland

tellings.quote: cases people are talking about Nuno Lorero who basically ran MIT's plasma fusion lab.

plain: A handful of scientists and officials tied to MIT, Caltech and Wright-Patterson Air Force Base are said to have died or gone missing, among them Nuno Loureiro, who Michels says "basically ran MIT's plasma fusion lab", along with Carl Gilmore and Neil McCasland. Michels raises these himself as "cases people are talking about", naming them in passing without saying what happened to each or where he heard it. If there were a pattern, it would suggest someone is targeting people close to sensitive research.
